# API response times (generated by scripts/perf/api_timings.py)

Machine: GitHub Actions runner (4 vCPU, 15 GB RAM), SQL Server 2022 Developer and the API in Docker.

| Endpoint | Median ms | p95 ms |
|---|---:|---:|
| List, no filter, page 1 (`/api/requests`) | 13.4 | 24.9 |
| List, one status (`/api/requests?status=Waiting`) | 5.8 | 6.1 |
| List, 2 statuses + priority + date (`/api/requests?status=InProgress&status=Waiting&priority=High&createdFrom=2025-06-01`) | 9.6 | 12.8 |
| List, handler (`/api/requests?assignedTo=דוד פרידמן`) | 4.4 | 4.5 |
| List, organization prefix (`/api/requests?organizationName=כרמל`) | 7.1 | 9.1 |
| List, free-text search (`/api/requests?search=היתר`) | 315.2 | 342.9 |
| List, page 500 sorted by title (`/api/requests?page=500&pageSize=100&sortBy=title&sortDirection=asc`) | 210.6 | 263.0 |
| Summary, no filter (cache) (`/api/requests/summary`) | 0.9 | 1.6 |
| Summary, priority High (`/api/requests/summary?priority=High`) | 7.8 | 11.7 |
| Request details (`/api/requests/50000`) | 1.5 | 1.7 |
| History (`/api/requests/50000/history`) | 2.2 | 2.3 |
| Lookups (`/api/lookups`) | 46.6 | 55.4 |
